colormaps.name: fire
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_L3 — perceptually-uniform black → red → yellow → white. Alternative to inferno with cleaner luminance ramp.
colormaps.citation: Kovesi (2015), 'Good Colour Maps: How to Design Them', arXiv:1509.03700
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: kbc
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_L7 — black → blue → cyan. PU alternative to ice/oslo with brighter mid-range.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: bgy
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_L9 — blue → green → yellow. PU alternative to viridis with cooler midtones.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: bmw
colormaps.description: Kovesi blue → magenta → white. Distinctive hue path; good for fields where red/yellow palettes are reserved for other channels.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: bkr
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_D1 — blue ↔ black ↔ red. PU diverging with dark center; emphasises high-magnitude tails.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: bjy
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_D7 — blue ↔ yellow PU diverging through near-white. Different hue pair from coolwarm/vik.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: colorwheel
colormaps.description: Kovesi cyclic isoluminant colorwheel. Perfect hue rotation for phase / orientation fields.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: glasbey
colormaps.description: Glasbey et al. max-distinct categorical palette. Far more distinct categories than tab10/Set2 (256 maximally distinguishable colors).
colormaps.citation: Glasbey, van der Heijden, Toh & Gray (2007), 'Colour displays for categorical images', Color Research & Application
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: kr
colormaps.description: Kovesi black → red PU sequential. Dark-anchored monochromatic red; complements amp (white-anchored).
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: kg
colormaps.description: Kovesi black → green PU sequential. Dark-anchored monochromatic green; counterpart to kr/kb in the RGB triad.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: kb
colormaps.description: Kovesi black → blue PU sequential. Pure-blue monochromatic; distinct from kbc which veers cyan in the upper range.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: cjm
colormaps.description: Kovesi isoluminant diverging cyan ↔ magenta through jade (L=75). Use for signed data overlaid on grayscale imagery — luminance stays constant so the underlying structure reads through. Not a general-purpose diverging map (luminance discrimination beats hue).
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: cjo
